heading: Notification of certain individuals regarding options for enrollment under Medicare part B

children.text: As soon as practicable, the Secretary of Defense shall notify each individual described in subsection (b)—
that the individual is no longer eligible for health care benefits under the TRICARE program under this chapter; and
of options available for enrollment of the individual in the supplementary medical insurance program under part B of title XVIII of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395j et seq.).
In carrying out this subsection, the Secretary of Defense shall—
establish procedures for identifying individuals described in subsection (b); and
consult with the Secretary of Health and Human Services to accurately identify and notify such individuals.

tree.heading: Individuals Described.—
tree.text: An individual described in this subsection is an individual who is—

children.text: entitled to benefits under part A of title XVIII of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395c) under section 226(b) or section 226A of such Act (42 U.S.C. 426(b) and 426–1); and
eligible to enroll in the supplementary medical insurance program under part B of such title (42 U.S.C. 1395j et seq.).

notes.text: References in TextThe Social Security Act, referred to in subsecs. (a)(1)(B) and (b)(2), (3), is act Aug. 14, 1935, ch. 531, 49 Stat. 620. Parts A and B of title XVIII of the Act are classified generally to parts A (§ 1395c et seq.) and B (§ 1395j et seq.), respectively, of subchapter XVIII of chapter 7 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare. For complete classification of this Act to the Code, see section 1305 of Title 42 and Tables.
